candidate.title: TruSeq RNA
candidate.scope: The single product-preparation outline titled TruSeq RNA in the assigned Illumina poster panel, from polyadenylated mRNA through poly(A) selection, fragmentation, random-hexamer priming and first- and second-strand synthesis. The endpoint shown is double-stranded cDNA, an RNA-derived library intermediate; adapter addition, amplification, sequencing and a data readout are outside the depicted route. No particular kit version is identified, and no alternative workflow or branch is shown. The card is secondary catalogue evidence and supplies no primary-paper references.

operations.label: polyA select
operations.description: The input polyadenylated mRNA is represented after selection with its A-rich tail paired to a T-rich tract beside a gray capture support. The output differs from the input in its selected, support-associated state.
operations.mechanism: Interpreted as complementary poly(A)-oligo(dT) capture from the depicted AAAAA/TTTTT pair; the figure does not specify the gray support material.
operations.information_effect: Selection makes the represented population dependent on the depicted poly(A) feature. It supports enrichment for polyadenylated RNA, not perfect specificity for every biological mRNA or coverage of all RNA classes.

operations.information_effect: The depicted material becomes subtranscript fragments rather than continuous input RNA; later cDNA therefore represents portions of the selected transcripts.

operations.label: Random hexamer
operations.description: Short blue random-hexamer primers associate with the fragmented RNA, creating the primed template material that enters strand synthesis. The caption is line-wrapped as Random hexam-er in the source.
operations.mechanism: Random-hexamer priming is interpreted from the caption and the short blue segments alongside purple RNA fragments; individual primer sequences and enzymes are unspecified.
operations.information_effect: Primer association supplies initiation sites for copying RNA fragments. The blue marks are interpreted as primers, with no depicted barcode or sample-identity function.

operations.label: First and second strand synthesis
operations.description: The random-hexamer-associated RNA fragments are copied through the combined first- and second-strand synthesis block into paired blue DNA fragments. The figure groups both strand-synthesis stages and does not show their internal intermediates.
operations.mechanism: RNA-directed first-strand copying followed by second-strand synthesis is the interpretation of the RNA-to-paired-strand transition; no enzyme identity or strand-specific chemistry is supplied.
operations.information_effect: The physical sequence carrier changes from selected RNA fragments to double-stranded cDNA. This material represents sequence regions of the selected polyadenylated transcripts. A downstream sequence read could interrogate those copied regions, but no sequencing, count measurement or strand-of-origin encoding is depicted here.
